analysis.summary: Management reported a strong performance in Q1 FY27, driven by core business scalability and new branch expansion, while noting that Dubai revenues faced temporary pressure due to war conditions. The company successfully completed development of its digital platform, AkikoPay, which is now live on Android and rolling out on Apple's App Store. Management raised its FY27 revenue guidance to INR325 crores to INR350 crores and expressed confidence in maintaining a 9% to 11% PAT margin for the year alongside a long-term 3-year CAGR target of 70% to 100%. Akiko Global Services Limited released its investor presentation for Q1 FY27, reporting strong revenue growth and healthy profitability alongside expansion in its credit card sourcing and loan disbursal operations. Management highlighted the continued scaling of its digital platform, AkikoPay, following the recent launch of its upgraded Android version.

guidance.claim: Management revised its FY27 revenue guidance to INR325 crores to INR350 crores.
guidance.quote: Earlier, I had given a target of INR300 crores. Now I am revising this guidance. I am very comfortable to get INR325 crores to INR350 crores this FY27.

guidance.claim: Management expects PAT margins for the year to be between 9% and 11%.
guidance.quote: Sir, I am confident of 9% to 11% for this year.

guidance.claim: Management projected a 3-year CAGR of 70% to 100% year-on-year basis.
guidance.quote: Because my vision is very clear for the next 3 years that our CAGR will remain the same at 70% to 100% year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability.
guidance.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

guidance.claim: The company expects 70% to 100% revenue growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: I would like to give an outlook for FY27, which approximately I am expecting a target of 70% to 100% revenue growth, we have taken a minimum.

guidance.claim: Profit margins will remain with similar profitability in FY27.
guidance.quote: And profit margins will also remain with similar profitability.

guidance.claim: The company has a long-term vision to reach INR1,000 crores revenue by 2030 and take PAT margins to 12% to 13%.
guidance.quote: And we have also taken a long-term vision of 2030. We have a proper clear vision that we build INR1,000 crores revenue by 2030 and take PAT margins further to 12% to 13%.

guidance.claim: Management expects INR50 crores revenue from AkikoPay in FY27.
guidance.quote: In FY27, I am expecting around INR50 crores revenue from AkikoPay.

guidance.claim: Management expects FY27 revenue to be INR300 crores or above.
guidance.quote: Otherwise, I am expecting my outlook for 2027 is INR300 crores. That is not going below INR300 crores, this is going to be above INR300 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the sourcing pipeline is healthy, providing good visibility for upcoming quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: Bank partnerships are strong, and the sourcing pipeline is healthy, due to which we see good visibility for the upcoming quarters as well.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the offline core business and distribution are increasing month-on-month by 4% to 7%.
demand_outlook.quote: Unlike other fintechs that burn money in their initial years, we are not focusing on losing money at all because our offline business, our core business, and our distribution are increasing month-on-month by 4% to 7%.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that around 70% of sourcing is happening digitally.
demand_outlook.quote: The most important thing is that almost 70% of sourcing is now happening digitally, which is improving productivity and making customer acquisition costs better, and targeting capabilities are also becoming stronger.

demand_outlook.claim: A physical presence increases lead conversion rates from 10% to between 60% and 80%.
demand_outlook.quote: Where our digital conversion rate is 10%, with physical presence, that conversion reaches 60% to 80%, which we have felt over the last two years.

demand_outlook.claim: Initial user engagement trends on AkikoPay are healthy with repeat transactions.
demand_outlook.quote: And user engagement trends are also very healthy. And the most positive thing is that users are actively doing repeat transactions, which will give us confidence with long-term engagement and stickiness.

demand_outlook.claim: Dubai business revenue has revived starting from April onwards.
demand_outlook.quote: And, it has started reviving again from April onwards.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to open a total of 25 branches this year.
capex_expansion.quote: There is a plan for 25 branches in total.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its company-owned branch presence in multiple cities including Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Pune, Jaipur, Chandigarh, Lucknow, Kolkata, and Patna.
capex_expansion.quote: Along with this, we have also expanded our company-owned branch presence in multiple cities. Like Delhi NCR is known to everyone, Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Pune, Jaipur, Chandigarh, Lucknow, Kolkata, Patna, and many emerging markets.

capex_expansion.claim: The company increased its branch count from 3 or 4 in the last quarter to 16 branches across India.
capex_expansion.quote: I mean, where we had three or four branches in the last quarter, today we have 16 branches across India.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that unsecured average payout is 3.10%.
margins_costs.quote: In unsecured, our average payout itself is 3.10%.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that customer acquisition on AkikoPay will be at a negligible cost using employees and existing database.
margins_costs.quote: We will acquire customers at a negligible cost using only our employees and existing database.

margins_costs.claim: AkikoPay enables efficient customer acquisition with approximately 40% lower CAC versus traditional channels.
margins_costs.quote: ~40% lower CAC vs traditional channels, enabled by a lean, digital-first model

margins_costs.claim: Margin pressure in Q4 was driven by planned investments in branch expansion, technology infrastructure, and the AkikoPay scale-up.
margins_costs.quote: This was due to our planned investment towards branch expansion, this was the most important thing, in which some of our money has been spent on that. Some of our money has been spent in technology infrastructure, on the AkikoPay scale-up initiative.

margins_costs.claim: Temporary margin pressure also occurred in Dubai operations due to the geopolitical situation around the Iran region.
margins_costs.quote: And some of our margin pressure has come in Dubai operations, there has been temporary margin pressure due to the current geopolitical situation, as you all know, around the Iran region.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated current team strength is around 950 employees.
orders_capacity.quote: In the investor deck, it has been mentioned that the employee strength is around odd 950.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated the company operates 25 branches across 19 cities in India.
orders_capacity.quote: So, we have 25 branches across 19 cities in India.

orders_capacity.claim: Monthly loan disbursals increased to over ₹450 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: Operational execution remained strong during the quarter, with monthly loan disbursals increasing to over ₹450 crore, while monthly credit card sourcing scaled to 17,000–18,000 cards, driven by the Company's expanding distribution capabilities, technology-enabled customer acquisition platform, and deep banking and NBFC partnerships.

orders_capacity.claim: The company successfully disburses 16,000+ credit cards on a month-on-month basis.
orders_capacity.quote: If we talk about the credit card segment, which used to be our core business at one time, today we successfully disburse 16,000+ credit cards on a month-on-month basis.

orders_capacity.claim: Partnerships have been built with 40+ banks and NBFCs, including 20 to 25 new partnerships built this year.
orders_capacity.quote: And we have built partnerships with 40+ banks and NBFCs, in which 20 to 25 new partnerships have been built this year.

orders_capacity.claim: The loan business monthly disbursement run rate has reached INR400 crores+, resulting in an annual book of INR5,000 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, we have reached a monthly disbursement run rate of INR400 crores+, which if we count annually, our book has become INR5,000 crores as of today.

orders_capacity.claim: Total combined workforce, including employees and channel partners, has crossed 900+.
orders_capacity.quote: Reflecting this scale-up, our total combined workforce, including employees and channel partners, has now crossed 900+, which is a very strong growth compared to last year.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated there is absolutely no plan for fundraising right now.
capital_allocation.quote: No, sir. There is absolutely no plan for fundraising right now.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that Dubai revenue faced pressure during the quarter due to war conditions.
risks_headwinds.quote: In Dubai, due to war, our total revenue for the entire quarter was INR1.25 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Dubai operations experienced temporary margin pressure and a revenue dip due to the geopolitical situation around the Iran region.
risks_headwinds.quote: And some of our margin pressure has come in Dubai operations, there has been temporary margin pressure due to the current geopolitical situation, as you all know, around the Iran region.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the Apple App Store version of AkikoPay will be implemented within a week.
management_commitments.quote: Customers are also really liking our new Android version and this same version will be implemented on Apple's App Store within a week.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects receivable days to come down to within 90 days in Q2.
management_commitments.quote: In Q2, I see receivable days coming down to within 90 days.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to reach around INR1,000 crores loan disbursement by December end.
management_commitments.quote: plus by December end, we will reach around INR1,000 crores disbursement.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore.
management_commitments.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

management_commitments.claim: The iOS version is progressing as planned and is expected to offer a similar comprehensive experience in the coming months.
management_commitments.quote: The iOS version is progressing as planned and is expected to offer a similar comprehensive experience in the coming months.

management_commitments.claim: AkikoPay will be live on iOS with all features within the current month.
management_commitments.quote: So most likely within this month, AkikoPay will be live on iOS with all features.

management_commitments.claim: Everything in one ecosystem including UPI capabilities, AI-led financial tools, and insurance products will be seen within the next quarter.
management_commitments.quote: And in the coming time, UPI capabilities, AI-led financial tools, and onboarding improvements, like reward ecosystem, travel integration in a proper way, insurance products are going to come. So most likely within the next quarter, you will see everything in one ecosystem.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to take the unsecured book from INR400 crores to INR1,000 crores by March 31st.
management_commitments.quote: By FY27, my target is INR1,000 crores of unsecured book. So, the INR400 crores is to be taken to INR1,000 crores. This is my complete vision, complete target till 31st March.

management_commitments.claim: Mutual funds and insurance are going to be live by August onwards.
management_commitments.quote: So mutual fund and insurance going to be live by August onwards because for that I have applied for some IRDAI license.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
